slots.note: Key part with no card (rule 16 exception).

phen.effect: water pressure grows with depth

hydroelectric-power-station.flag: Dam listed as a key-part gap; the 1882 Vulcan Street plant had only a low dam and a water wheel, so drop it if the card means the generic station only loosely. Induction sits with Electric generators (rule 23).

escalator.flag: Chain drive filled by Gear train, as Bicycle's chain drive is. Rubber handrail left off (minor).

slots.note: Stand-in: the only drilled-well card; these wells bring up steam, not oil.

phen.effect: the Earth's interior is hot
hot water flashes into steam when its pressure drops

geothermal-power.flag: Turbines rather than Steam turbine: that card includes a boiler, which a geothermal plant doesn't have. Earth's internal heat is the card's key effect, no card. Boiling points is the existing gap (Distillation, Pressure cooker), now a third use.

phen.effect: chromium forms a thin oxide film that seals the metal and re-forms when scratched

stainless-steel.flag: Passivation is the key effect, no card; kept on the alloy since Chromium is one ingredient (rule 24). Nickel (in most stainless) has no card.

traffic-light.flag: Own job 'communicates' (it signals drivers); no 'controls traffic' job. Timer and road sensors left off: the 1914 signal was switched by hand. LEDs as 'later' (1990s).

phen.effect: a cross between two inbred lines grows unusually vigorous

hybrid-corn.flag: Both are key and unshared (rule 16 exception). Maize itself has no card; Agriculture isn't a stand-in for a crop.

fibreglass.flag: Own job 'insulates' (glass wool, the 1932 use); 'forms the body' fits the later resin-composite use equally well. Trapped air and flexible thin strands are material properties (rule 28). Resin belongs to the composite, not fibreglass.

phen.effect: a liquid soaks up heat as it evaporates and gives it up as it condenses
squeezing the vapour heats it

heat-pump.flag: Same parts as Refrigerators/Air conditioning; Refrigerators not a slot (rule 6, same machine run backwards). Freon assumed for the 1938 Zurich unit; check. Effects match Air conditioning's wording.

offshore-oil-platform.flag: Own job follows Oil wells and Coal mining (no 'extracts fuel' job; only Fracking would share it). Oil wells as a slot is a rule 6 vs rule 7 call: the platform is oil wells moved to sea, but the wells are physically in it; drop if it reads as the same thing.

slots.note: Key part with no card: Ridley's canopy plastic (PMMA).

phen.effect: refraction

cataract-lens-implant.flag: Acrylic plastic (PMMA) would also be the Hip replacement's bone cement; two uses here, so not yet 3.

tunnel-boring-machine.flag: Conveyor left off (no card, not shared). Rolling disc cutters came in 1956, four years after the card; hard steel cutters were there from 1952.

slots.note: Stand-in: the 1954 link used mercury-arc valves, the only rectifier card is the vacuum diode.

hvdc-power-lines.flag: No own-level effect: avoiding cable-charging losses is an absence, not an effect it works by. Thyristor valves (c. 1970) have no card.

slots.note: Stand-in: the only crane card; dock cranes are gantry cranes.

container-shipping.flag: Crane job 'transports' follows the Tower crane's own job (no 'lifts' job). Trucks and trains left off to keep it tight; twist-lock fittings have no card.

wind-turbine.flag: Lift sits with Wing (rule 23), induction with Electric generators. Windmill not a slot (rule 5: borrowed idea, not physically inside).

slots.note: Stand-in: the only insulated-vessel card, made for liquefied gases; the ship's tanks are insulated with balsa or foam, not a vacuum.

phen.effect: the liquid that boils off carries heat away and keeps the rest cold

liquefied-natural-gas-tanker.flag: Natural gas: possible shared gap with Gas-turbine power station (fuel); Fracking and Offshore oil platform produce it but don't contain it. Dewar flask stand-in is a judgment call.

slots.note: Existing key-part gap from Jet planes.
Stand-in: the only propeller card; the fan is a ducted many-bladed propeller.

phen.effect: reaction thrust

turbofan-jet-engine.flag: Jet engine gap is already on the board (Jet planes' key part); Gas-turbine power station ('essentially a jet engine') may share it. Screw propeller as the fan is a stand-in; drop if too loose.

artificial-hip-joint-replacement.flag: Own job follows Cochlear implant and Hearing aid ('bears the load' would also do). Acrylic bone cement left off: no card, shared only with Cataract lens implant so far. Low friction is a material property (rule 28).

high-speed-rail.flag: Steam locomotive not a slot (rule 5). Pantograph has no card.

phen.effect: bone grows right up against titanium and locks onto it

dental-implant.flag: Osseointegration is the key effect (rule 25: a body process it works with), no card; kept on the implant since Titanium has no card either. Porcelain for the crown is typical, not stated in the text; drop if too loose.

atm-cash-machine.flag: Own job 'makes payments', the new job batch 1 proposed (Credit card, Mobile payments, Online shopping). Card reader left off: the 1967 machine took carbon-14 vouchers; magnetic stripes and online PIN checks came in the 1970s, so keypad/phone line/computer are 'added later' in strict terms.

quartz-watch.flag: Piezoelectricity sits with Quartz oscillator (rule 23). Electronic watch not a slot (rule 5, its tuning fork isn't inside).

slots.note: Key part with no card: the herb it is extracted from.

phen.effect: a chemical kills the germ but not the patient

artemisinin-malaria-drug.flag: Wording matches Quinine synthesis and Quinacrine. The iron-triggered peroxide bridge is the specific mechanism; no card states it.

slots.note: Key part with no card (a polyester, not Polyethylene).

plastic-bottle.flag: Stretch blow-moulding is how it's made (rule 4); aligned molecules are a material property (rule 28).

phen.effect: a positron meets an electron and both vanish into two gamma rays flying apart
reconstruction from projections

pet-scanner.flag: Coincidence counter fits literally: PET counts the paired gamma rays arriving together. Radioactive decay sits with Radioactive tracers (rule 23). Positron annihilation is the key effect, no card. Computing slot and reconstruction follow CAT scan.

phen.effect: multiplying two primes is easy, but finding them from the product is not

public-key-encryption.flag: Maths the job carries out (rule 22); no number-theory card, so a key-effect gap. Own job 'protects' as for Cylinder locks.

spreadsheet.flag: VisiCalc ran on the Apple II, so Personal computer is the device it's carried out with (rule 3). No nameable effect.

slots.note: Key part with no card; Taq polymerase came in 1988.

phen.effect: heat parts DNA's two strands, and matching strands pair up again as it cools

pcr-dna-copying.flag: Base pairing is shared with CRISPR (guide RNA pairs with DNA) and would suit DNA sequencing; 2 new cards here. Primers are made by Gene synthesis, which is production (rule 4).

insecticide-treated-bed-nets.flag: Mesh may be polyester rather than nylon; Nylon is the only synthetic-fibre card. The village-wide drop in malaria is about the disease and its spread, not an effect the net works by (rule 25).

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows

statins.flag: Shared gap with Antiretroviral HIV therapy (2 new cards). Own job could be 'prevents disease' (it cuts the risk of heart attacks); followed Beta blockers. The mould it came from is how it was found/made, not an ingredient worth a gap.

phen.effect: chemicals carry signals between nerves

antidepressants-ssris.flag: Rule 25: the body process it works with. Blocking the reuptake pump has no card; not shared.

phen.effect: a reaction drives a current
lithium ions slip in between the layers of a crystal and out again

lithium-ion-battery.flag: Follows Lithium battery's lithium slot and effect. Intercalation is the key effect, no card. Cobalt-oxide cathode and graphite anode left off (Cobalt would be a weak 'is an ingredient' in an object; graphite has no card). Lithium battery not a slot (rule 6).

phen.effect: a cell follows genes put into it

genetically-modified-crops.flag: No slots: inserting the gene (Agrobacterium, gene gun, Genetic engineering) is how it's made (rule 4), and the borrowed gene varies by crop (Bt toxin is only the common example). Could add 'is an ingredient: gap Borrowed gene' if a material must show ingredients.

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows
a chemical kills the germ but not the patient

antiretroviral-hiv-therapy.flag: Enzyme inhibition shared with Statins (2 new cards; both key). The individual drugs (AZT, protease inhibitors) have no cards. Chemotherapy may be redundant with enzyme inhibition; drop one if so.

streaming-video.flag: Uses batch 1's new job 'compresses data'. Buffering has no card.

fracking.flag: Own job follows Oil wells / Coal mining. Oil wells may fall under rule 8 (what the technique is used on); drop it if so. Key effect (fluid pressure splits rock, sand props cracks open) has no card and I couldn't name one that isn't the card itself; left off.

robotic-surgery.flag: A practice made of another practice (rule 3). Camera sits with Keyhole surgery. 'cuts' for the robot arms is the nearest job; no 'manipulates' job.

cloud-data-centres.flag: Joule heating is a waste the cooling deals with, not an effect it works by.

phen.effect: braking runs the motor as a generator, turning motion back into charge

electric-car.flag: Induction is a different effect from the motor's own (a magnet pushes a current), so allowed (rule 23). Same effect as Hybrid car's regenerative braking.

phen.effect: the guide RNA pairs with the matching letters of DNA
the cell repairs a cut in its DNA, disabling or rewriting the gene

crispr-gene-editing.flag: Base pairing shared with PCR. Restriction enzymes (existing gap on Recombinant DNA) is close to Cas9 but cuts only at fixed sites; kept separate.

self-driving-cars.flag: Car slot by rule 7 (Waymo's driverless fleet is electric Jaguars; earlier test cars were hybrid). Cameras left off to keep it tight. Signal delay sits with Laser rangefinder and Radar.

large-language-models.flag: Own job 'writes' (it answers, writes and translates); 'computes' or 'communicates' would also do. Training on text is how it's made (rule 4); data centres kept because it also runs on them.
